subject: Physics A Level
note: Cambridge International AS & A Level Physics 9702, 2025-2027 syllabus. Topic names and the `papers` scoping follow the official Content overview (syllabus p10): topics 1-11 are AS Level, examined on Paper 1 (Multiple Choice) and Paper 2 (AS Structured); topics 12-25 are A Level, examined on Paper 4. Paper 5 (Planning, Analysis and Evaluation) draws its context from anywhere in the syllabus, so every topic lists it. Paper 3 (Advanced Practical Skills) is not collected. Errors and uncertainties are subtopic 1.3, not a topic of their own; electromagnetic induction is subtopic 20.5 of Magnetic fields. Communications and Electronics were dropped after the 2021 syllabus - questions on them in 2020-2021 papers are marked status='excluded'. Paper 1 MCQ mark schemes are answer-key lists that link_ms cannot segment; compose shows 'not available'. Keywords use plain text as it appears in extracted Cambridge PDF text, not LaTeX.
